Findings triage: **closing — the premise is already fixed on main.** The card measured the published `@objectstack/spec@17.0.0-rc.5`, which predates the fix.

- On `origin/main` @ `73f69dc`, `BaseSharingRuleSchema` spreads `...MetadataProtectionFields` (`packages/spec/src/security/sharing.zod.ts`, the ADR-0010 envelope block), with an in-place comment naming this exact failure: "This shape is `.strict()`, so until now that stamped envelope was not merely dropped — it was REJECTED … #6245 binds that door, so declaring the envelope is what keeps the new 422 aimed at malformed AUTHOR input instead of at the runtime's own stamp."
- `MetadataProtectionFields` carries `_packageId` (`packages/spec/src/kernel/metadata-protection.zod.ts:117`), so `safeParse` of a stamped body no longer fails `unrecognized_keys`, and the read-modify-write 422 the card reasons toward has no remaining mechanism.
- The `metadata-protocol` stamping site the card quotes is live (`protocol.ts:3914-3916`) and now round-trips against a schema that declares the key.
- The objectui#3561 downstream note stands on its own (client-not-stricter-than-server is right regardless), and the "can that restriction be lifted" follow-up becomes actionable as soon as the next rc publish picks the envelope up.

Maintainer may veto by reopening. Closed per the findings-triage veto-window model, not awaiting approval.
